title: Paris
summary: Paris blends monumental art and architecture with neighborhood warmth. Masterpieces, café culture, and walkable quartiers make it ideal for both first-timers and repeat visitors.
bestTime: Mar–Jun and Sep–Oct for mild weather; Jan–Feb for museum time and deals; Aug quieter but some closures.

attractions.name: Louvre Museum
attractions.summary: The world’s largest art museum; reserve timed entry and focus on one wing.

attractions.name: Eiffel Tower
attractions.summary: Book sunset slots; great views from Trocadéro and Seine cruise.

attractions.name: Montmartre & Sacré-Cœur
attractions.summary: Village-like streets, artists’ square, basilica views.

cultureEtiquette: Greet with bonjour/bonsoir before asking questions.
Tipping modest (round up); service usually included.
gettingAround: Buy a Navigo Easy card and load tickets; Metro covers most sights.
RER for airports/Versailles; buses offer scenic routes.
sustainability: Use Vélib’ shared bikes and tap water fountains.

faqs.a: Navigo Easy for transport; Museum Pass if doing many museums.
